system_context.architecture: Father's laptop (contains project folder + Kiro/Antigravity for vibe coding) -> SMB/CIFS Shared Folder -> Home Lab (Windows 11 + VMware) -> Ubuntu Server 24.04 VM -> Docker Container (artilora-nuxt-1).

failed_approaches: Rebuilding Docker repeatedly without checking cache
historical_issues_and_resolutions.verified_solution: Always command user to Hard Refresh/Clear Cache (Ctrl+Shift+R or Ctrl+Shift+Delete) after any deployment.
historical_issues_and_resolutions.conceptual_lesson: The browser aggressively caches Nuxt static assets. Hot-reloading works in dev, but when major structural changes happen, cache clearing is mandatory to see reality.

failed_approaches: Using `$(...)` in inline plink -batch commands on Windows
Piping stdin to sudo (echo password | sudo -S) which hangs
historical_issues_and_resolutions.verified_solution: Use NOPASSWD for sudo or write complex commands into an `.sh` script, transfer via pscp, and execute remotely.
historical_issues_and_resolutions.conceptual_lesson: Windows local shell will interpolate variables before Plink sends them. Remote scripting creates an impenetrable isolation layer that guarantees execution integrity.

historical_issues_and_resolutions.issue: File Sync Drift Between Local and Server
failed_approaches: Assuming editing local memory files also updated the server
Modifying docker-compose.yml on the server directly
historical_issues_and_resolutions.verified_solution: Perform strict byte-count verification (`wc -c`) between local and remote files before any migration.
historical_issues_and_resolutions.conceptual_lesson: Separated file systems will drift without strict synchronization disciplines. Trust, but verify via tooling.

failed_approaches: Adding generic Tailwind classes like z-50 blindly
Overlaying thick visual grids that obstructed text
historical_issues_and_resolutions.verified_solution: Removed grid from all image zones (Gallery), localized the grid effect, and enforced strict left alignment for textual content.
historical_issues_and_resolutions.conceptual_lesson: Less is more. Pixel-perfect control must be maintained within the Vue components directly rather than relying on abstract wireframing imports.

agent_instructions.prime_directive: Read this file upon entry. You are restoring your brain. Do not repeat historical mistakes.
agent_instructions.rule_1: NEVER repeat a failing approach. If it fails twice, STOP. Read the logs, search documentation, write a debug script, formulate a new hypothesis.
agent_instructions.rule_2: ALWAYS restart the Docker container (`docker restart artilora-nuxt-1` or via `docker-restart.ps1`) after altering configuration files.
agent_instructions.rule_3: Do NOT break the aesthetic. Use Bradley Hand ITC, smooth golden gradients, and dark luxury themes. Minimalist, premium, ethereal.
agent_instructions.rule_4: Do NOT use generic commands without verifying their effects. Do NOT use abstract design software; modify Nuxt/Tailwind CSS files directly for pixel perfection.
agent_instructions.rule_5: When completing a major implementation or bug fix, explicitly update BOTH PROJECT_MEMORY.md and this MACHINE-MEMORY.json.
